name: bug-coplanar-faces
bug_comment: Demonstrates the coplanar-tool-face known issue. Cutout 'flush (bug)' has its +Y face exactly on the plate's outer face at y=8.75; 'clear (control)' is the same box pulled 1mm inboard. Only the flush one leaves open edges.

cutouts.name: flush (bug)
cutouts.comment: box spans y 0.75..8.75 - its +Y face lies IN the plate's outer face plane

cutouts.name: clear (control)
cutouts.comment: identical box 1mm inboard, so no face is coplanar - this one is clean
